//: The App Store marketing images, one panel per image in the listing's order (marketing/appstore/README.md). Each shows one screenshot (scenes.json) in its device, light or dark, under a headline (\n breaks a line; *words* are set in Hammock's colours) and a subline. `devices` lays the same panels out for each device. marketing/scripts/appstore-marketing.ts only draws what this says. A device's frame is in its frame colour for the panel's theme, where frames-cli has more than one. frameDevice names the frame where the screenshot's size matches more than one (the iPhone: the 17 Pro Max simulator takes them).
